Name: SunsetJen's Hooty
Author: SunsetJen
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod changes many faces on statues and furniture in the valley into Hooty from the Owl House. (May be a little scuffed because some faces are very small.) This is basically a shitpost I made in an afternoon lol[/color]

[size=4][b]How to install:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later and Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and extract the ZIP folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 (or later) and Content Patcher[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs:[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to various youtubers, who called the owl statue "Hooty" and inspired this nonsense.[/color][/size]
